description: This file defines the MtpDeviceInfo class, which manages and reads device information for MTP (Media Transfer Protocol) devices, including parsing data packets and storing device properties.

classes.name: MtpDeviceInfo
classes.description: Class representing MTP device information, capable of reading data packets and storing device properties.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads device information from an MtpDataPacket and populates the class members.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Outputs the device information to the log.
